original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚阿南布拉州一燃气厂发生火灾，两人受伤
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚阿南布拉州奥赖菲特Amingo燃气厂发生火灾，两人被严重烧伤，部分财产被毁。据称火灾由一辆燃气罐车发动机点火引发，波及厂区一部分。伤者已被送往附近医院治疗，无人员死亡记录。州消防人员到场后将火势控制。

location.raw_text: Amingo Gas Plant in Oraifite, Ekwusigo Local Government Area of Anambra State

key_facts.fact: 阿南布拉州奥赖菲特Amingo燃气厂发生火灾，两人被严重烧伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Two persons were badly burnt and other properties destroyed when a fire outbreak occurred at the Amingo Gas Plant in Oraifite, Ekwusigo Local Government Area of Anambra State.

key_facts.fact: 据称火灾由燃气罐车发动机点火引发
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the fire outbreak was triggered by an ignition from the engine of a gas tanker

key_facts.fact: 无人员死亡记录，伤者被送往附近医院
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Although no deaths were recorded, an eyewitness said the injured persons were immediately rushed to a nearby hospital for treatment.

key_facts.fact: 州消防人员到场后将火势控制
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the fire raged for several minutes before operatives of the state fire service arrived and brought it under control

uncertainties: 火灾起因系目击者说法，尚未获官方证实
伤者伤情及具体人数细节有待核实
目前仅单一来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
